description: Call this when the user asks what changed, or before relying on a verdict older than a day. Returns recent changes, newest first: verdict changes, new failures by type, moved quotes, changed pay-to addresses, sellers added or reaching 30 paid calls, published seller replies, the operator-reported series maturing or disagreeing with ours. Each change has its time, type, seller domain, seller page and type-specific details (for example the old and new quote).

host.description: Seller to show changes for, as a bare domain such as api.example.com; omit for every seller

since.description: Show only changes after this time, in ISO 8601 (such as the generated_at of a verdict you already have); omit for the latest changes

name: recent_changes

count.description: Matching changes the index returned (it caps the feed at the newest 500); events holds at most the newest 100

title: Recent changes to x402 sellers
